summary: Reproduced the review's non-HIP greedy TP divergence against candidate behavior and made finalized greedy accept-decision broadcasts backend-independent while preserving the candidate's valid ROCm, TP=1, and DP-attention coverage.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate cad9443 regression on the assigned GPU: three candidate tests passed.
Failing-before candidate behavior: non-HIP logical TP ranks retained different accepted-token counts, 3 versus 2.
Passing-after behavior: four GPU-backed tests covered HIP and non-HIP logical TP=2 synchronization, TP=1, and DP-attention routing.

gpu_evidence: Real torch tensors and argmax ran on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; collective behavior was replayed across logical ranks.
remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so no real two-rank process group, ROCm collective/deadlock, AITER all-reduce fusion, multi-node workload, full serving path, or model semantic accuracy was verified. No model weights were used. No native source changed.
